intro: Emily is convinced she is a lowly crow who landed in a phoenix nest by mistake, and she spends her days planning an escape before anyone finds out. Queen Angelina adopts her anyway. It reads like a fairy-tale fantasy novel, now on screen: a heroine who underestimates herself, a royal family that refuses to let her go, and a hidden heritage waiting to break through.
why: A heroine who thinks she is the weakest in the room, so every reveal lands harder.
Found-family warmth: a queen who chooses her long before the truth comes out.
Fairy-tale fantasy touches like a Magic Mirror and an ancient phoenix bloodline.
Good pick if you like hidden-identity fantasy with heart more than heavy revenge.

faq.q: What is Not Your Average Crow about?
faq.a: Emily believes she is an ordinary crow living among phoenixes and keeps trying to slip away before a trial exposes her. When the Magic Mirror shatters, she learns she is the long-lost Abyssal Phoenix and uncovers a plot against her new family.

faq.q: Is Not Your Average Crow worth watching?
